metaTitle: Custom Embroidery Badge Reels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom embroidery badge reels for your team. Durable, stitched logo reels perfect for daily ID use. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Embroidered badge reels offer a textured, upscale alternative to printed designs. The stitched logo stands up to daily wear and repeated retractions, making them ideal for corporate uniforms, hospital staff, or trade show teams. Choose full-color embroidery on nylon or polyester webbing for a professional look that lasts through countless badge scans.
heroAltText: Custom embroidery badge reels with stitched company logo on retractable cord
